'''Marcelo Samuel Berman''' (born [[Buenos Aires]], [[Argentina]]; 10 April 1945 – 4 May 2019) was an Argentine and Brazilian theoretical physicist specialized in relativistic cosmology, as well as a professor and journalist. He published books dealing with science, philosophy of science and learning techniques.<ref name=cv1a>[http://buscatextual.cnpq.br/buscatextual/visualizacv.do?id=K4787341U5 CV Officially verified by the Brazilian Federal Government]</ref>{{Failed verification|date=February 2016}} 

After finishing his engineering degree in electronics, Berman took graduate courses in theoretical physics at ITA, and received a Master of Science in physics in 1981 from the Technological Institute of Aeronautics, under the direction of Fernando de Mello Gomide, followed by a Doctor of Science in physics from the [[Federal University of Rio de Janeiro]] in 1988, under the direction of Murari Mohan Som,<ref name=cv1a />

He subsequently had post-doctoral studies at Department of Astronomy, [[University of Florida]] (1989–90) and part-time adjunct, or visiting positions at Department of Exact Sciences, FURJ (UNIVILLE), in Joinville, SC, Brazil, the [[University of Alabama, Tuscaloosa]], and Group of Cosmology and Gravitation, Division of Astrophysics, [[National Institute for Space Research]] (INPE), São José dos Campos, SP, Brazil.<ref name=cv1a />

His field of interest is the [[Gravitational wave|General Gravitational Theories]] and [[General relativity|Relativistic Cosmology]]; he has written about one hundred papers in refereed journals and ten books.{{cn|date=April 2024}}

From 1996 to 2000, he was Professor, Department of Physics, [[Instituto Tecnológico de Aeronáutica|ITA]] (Technological Institute of Aeronautics), São José dos Campos.<ref name=cv1a />{{Failed verification|date=February 2016}} He then served as Scientific Counselor, Tecpar (Technological Institute of Paraná). Curitiba, PR -Brazil from (2000-2002) and since 2006, the Scientific Director, Instituto Albert Einstein/Latinamerica, (Curitiba and Mafra). He died on May 4 2019.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-05-31 |title=Lista de falecimentos em Curitiba - 31/05/2019 |url=https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/curitiba/falecimentos/falecimentos-curitiba-31-05-2019/ |access-date=2026-07-23 |website=Gazeta do Povo |language=pt-BR}}</ref>
